_metadata.source: Medicare.gov 'Medicare Savings Programs' (2026 monthly income and resource limits); SSA POMS HI 03001.020 'Eligibility for Extra Help' (TN 32, 02-26) for 2026 Extra Help resource limits
_metadata.verification_note: MSP income limits are computed as ceil(annual FPL x pct / 12 + $20) from us_fpl_2026.json; every computed 48-state limit equals the figure Medicare.gov publishes for 2026 (pinned in tests). Resource limits are as published. Extra Help resource limits ($18,090 / $36,100, including $1,500 per person for burial expenses) are quoted in POMS HI 03001.020.
_metadata.scope_note: Federal floor only. States run MSPs and may disregard more income or waive the resource test (e.g. several states have no MSP asset test); those state expansions are not modeled.

tiers.name: Qualified Medicare Beneficiary
tiers.pays: Part A and B premiums, deductibles, coinsurance and copayments

tiers.name: Qualifying Individual
tiers.pays: Part B premium (first-come, first-served; reapply yearly)

extra_help.income_counting_note: Annual income, counted under SSI rules with the $20 general and $65 + 1/2 earned income exclusions (20 CFR 418.3301 et seq.); household size includes the applicant, spouse and dependent relatives living with them.

notes: MSP limits update when the poverty guidelines are published; states typically apply them from April 1.
QDWI (Qualified Disabled and Working Individuals) is not modeled.
